result.description:
General Dentist (Multiple Positions)
Mobile Dental Clinics Australia
Employer: Mobile Dental Clinics Australia (MDCA)
Salary: $150,000 plus superannuation and commission
Position Type: Full-Time
About the Employer
Founded in 2015, Mobile Dental Clinics Australia (MDCA) brings quality, on-site dental care to aged care residents and underserved communities across Australia, delivering treatment with dignity, compassion, and clinical excellence wherever patients need it most.
About the Role
The General Dentist is responsible for providing comprehensive, patient-centred dental care across MDCA's on-site clinics, servicing aged care facilities and community settings throughout Victoria. This role involves clinical assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, and the delivery of general dentistry services, ensuring high-quality care and positive outcomes for patients in a mobile care environment.
Your Responsibilities
?	Assessing and diagnosing oral health conditions using clinical examination, imaging, and patient history
?	Delivering preventive dental care, including periodontal treatment, fluoride application, and patient education on oral health promotion
?	Performing restorative treatments such as fillings, crowns, bridges, and implant-related procedures, repairing decayed or damaged teeth
?	Undertaking minor oral surgical procedures, including tissue biopsies and prescribing appropriate medication
?	Carrying out routine orthodontic treatment as required
?	Fitting and managing removable and fixed dental prostheses to restore oral function
?	Recognising oral signs of broader systemic health conditions (such as diabetes) and referring or managing accordingly
?	Educating patients on maintaining oral hygiene and long-term dental health
?	Providing clinical guidance and support to dental assistants and other members of the on-site care team
?	Maintaining accurate and compliant clinical records in accordance with practice and regulatory requirements
?	Travelling to designated aged care facilities and community sites as scheduled
About You
?	A patient-focused clinician committed to delivering high-quality care
?	Strong communication skills and a compassionate approach, particularly when working with elderly and vulnerable patients
?	Proficient across all aspects of general dentistry
?	Comfortable working independently and managing a varied caseload across multiple locations
?	Reliable, organised, and adaptable to a mobile care setting
Skills & Experience
?	Minimum Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) or equivalent tertiary qualification in dentistry
?	Current AHPRA registration as a General Dentist, with no restrictions
?	Minimum 1–3 years of full-time experience working as a Dentist
?	Current Radiation License
?	Current professional indemnity insurance
?	National Police Certificate (Police Check)

Job title:  Mobile Podiatrist 

  Job type:  Full time or part time 

  Job setting:  Community and home visits 

  Salary offer:  $100,000 – $115,000 + super (pro-rata for part-time) 

  Location:  Melbourne 

   

  About the company:   

 Our client is a well-established allied health provider delivering high-quality, home-based services across NSW since 2018 and now expanding into VIC. Their multidisciplinary team includes physiotherapists, occupational therapists, exercise physiologists, remedial massage therapists, and other allied health professionals, all working collaboratively to deliver personalised, client-centred care. 

 At the heart of their approach is the belief that everyone deserves access to quality healthcare in the comfort of their own home. They are committed to supporting independence, mobility, and meaningful participation in daily activities—whether that’s returning to hobbies, staying active, or spending time with family. All services are delivered in line with best-practice, evidence-informed care. 

   

  About the role:  

 Our client is seeking experienced Podiatrists to join their growing mobile allied health team in Melbourne. This is a community-based, home visit role providing podiatry services exclusively in clients’ homes—no clinic, no aged care facilities. 

 You will be responsible for delivering high-quality podiatric care to an adult caseload, supported by a strong administrative team and access to modern clinical systems and equipment. The role offers significant flexibility, with options for permanent full-time, part-time, or contractor arrangements depending on your preference. 

 This is an excellent opportunity for clinicians who enjoy autonomy, flexibility, and meaningful patient interaction in a mobile practice setting. 

   

  Benefits:  

 
	 Flexible engagement options: permanent full-time, part-time, or contractor 
	 Salary range: $100,000 – $115,000 + super (pro-rata for part-time) 
	 $1,000 CPD allowance for permanent staff 
	 $5,000 car allowance (permanent roles) 
	 Full administrative and scheduling support (referral-based booking system) 
	 Work-from-home flexibility for documentation and admin tasks 
	 Company-provided clinical equipment (including steriliser for permanent employees) 
	 Visa sponsorship available for eligible candidates 
	 KPI of approximately 29 visits per week (full-time) 
	 Supportive multidisciplinary team environment 
	 (visa sponsorship available if required) 
 

   

  Requirements:  

 
	 Minimum 2–3 years of post-graduate podiatry experience 
	 Experience in community-based or mobile Podiatry preferred 
	 Strong clinical skills in adult Podiatric care 
	 Ability to work independently and manage a mobile caseload 
	 Commitment to evidence-based, patient-centred care 
	 Full AHPRA registration as a Podiatrist 
	 Full Australian working rights 
	 Own vehicle and willingness to travel for home visits (car allowance provided for permanent staff)

Click the  Apply button  to submit your application and become part of our professional team.   Benefits   Why join ACETUNE MOBILE MECHANIC PTY. LTD.?   •    Competitive salary of $79,000 - $85,000 per annum, plus superannuation.  •    Permanent full-time position (40 hours per week).  •    Overtime opportunities and additional employee benefits.  •    Opportunity to join a growing business with a supportive team environment.      Task & responsibilities   Primary Objective:   This position is responsible for supporting the efficient operation of the company's mobile mechanical services by carrying out vehicle diagnostics, servicing, maintenance, and repairs. The role involves diagnosing and repairing engine, transmission, steering, suspension, braking, and electrical systems, conducting routine maintenance, and ensuring all work is completed to manufacturer specifications, Australian industry standards, and workplace health and safety requirements while delivering high-quality customer service.   Duties:   •    Travelling to customer locations using a fully equipped mobile service vehicle to perform mechanical servicing and repairs.  •    Conducting systematic inspections of petrol and diesel vehicles to identify mechanical and electrical faults.  •    Operating computerised diagnostic equipment and specialised testing instruments to accurately identify defects affecting vehicle performance.  •    Removing, dismantling and inspecting engines, transmissions, steering assemblies, braking systems, suspension components and other mechanical assemblies to determine the cause of faults.  •    Repairing or replacing worn, damaged or defective mechanical and electrical components using appropriate tools and manufacturer-approved repair procedures.  •    Reassembling engines and vehicle systems following repairs and ensuring all components are correctly fitted and securely installed.  •    Performing scheduled servicing including engine oil and filter replacement, lubrication, fluid replacement, tune-ups and preventative maintenance in accordance with manufacturers' specifications.  •    Carrying out post-repair testing, adjustments and quality checks to verify the safe and effective operation of repaired vehicles.  •    Responding to roadside breakdown call-outs and undertaking on-site fault diagnosis and repairs where practicable.  •    Advising customers regarding repair findings, maintenance requirements and recommended future repairs.  •    Maintaining accurate service records, repair reports and parts usage documentation.  •    Ensuring all work is completed in accordance with workplace health and safety requirements, environmental obligations and company quality standards.      Qualification & experience   Qualifications:   •    Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology.  •    Certificate IV (or Equivalent)   Experience:   •    At least three (3) years of relevant experience as a Motor Mechanic or Automotive Mechanic.  •    Experience in the automotive repair and servicing industry is preferred.  About Company     ACETUNE MOBILE MECHANIC PTY. The company provides reliable, high-quality automotive services to both private and commercial clients, with a strong focus on professionalism, safety, and customer satisfaction. As the business continues to grow, ACETUNE MOBILE MECHANIC PTY. LTD. remains committed to delivering efficient and dependable automotive solutions while maintaining Australian industry standards. result.description:
ABN AMRO Clearing (AAC) is a leading global player in clearing and clearing related services and strives to optimize profitability, return on invested capital and shareholders value. We have offices around the world, operating in Sydney since 1998; other main offices are located in Hong Kong, Tokyo, Singapore, Amsterdam, London, Chicago and Brazil. AAC is ambitious and customer oriented, striving to provide the best integrated service package for the professional business. AAC is a reliable partner, with efficient operations, compliant to all regulations and with a sound risk framework. 

The Software Engineer role contributes to AAC’s mission to optimize performance, risk management, and operational excellence by designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise software systems. The position ensures that applications are scalable, reliable, and compliant with financial regulations across APAC. 

The Software Engineer will report to the RAMS APAC Product Owner and be responsible for end-to-end design, development, migration, and optimization of critical clearing applications. This includes: 
• Designing system architecture for applications across Linux, Windows, PostgreSQL, MS SQL, and DB2 environments. 
• Leading upgrades and migrations of legacy applications to modern frameworks (Java, Angular, Python, Perl). 
• Ensuring integration, scalability, performance, and maintainability across APAC platforms. 

Key Responsibilities:
1. Software System Design & Architecture 
o Design and implement robust, scalable software architectures for LCM applications. 
o Evaluate and select frameworks, tools, and technologies to optimize system performance. 
o Define database structures and interactions to support enterprise systems. 
2. Development & Engineering 
o Develop, test, and maintain software solutions in Java, Python, Perl, and Angular, aligned with architectural design. 
o Apply engineering best practices (Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Maven, Bootstrap CSS) to ensure maintainable and high-quality code. 
3. Application Lifecycle Management 
o Own the full software lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, deployment, and support. 
o Lead migration projects, upgrading legacy systems to modern platforms while maintaining system integrity. 
4. Technical Leadership & Advisory 
o Provide guidance to Product Owners and the RAMS team on system design, technical decisions, and software strategy. 
o Evaluate software solutions for cost, risk, scalability, and integration into existing APAC systems. 
5. Collaboration & Documentation 
o Work closely with IT teams, Chapter Leads, and APAC CIO to maintain alignment between business needs and software architecture. 
o Produce and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and user manuals. 
6. Risk & Compliance Awareness 
o Ensure all system designs meet regulatory, security, and operational risk requirements. 
o Implement solutions to improve reliability, compliance, and performance of critical clearing systems. 

Required Knowledge and Experience Education: 
• IT-related university degree or equivalent. 
• At least 2+ years in software engineering or system architecture roles. 
• Experience in finance/clearing systems preferred. 

Technical Skills: 
• Software engineering and system architecture experience. 
• Programming: Java (mandatory), Python/Perl, Angular. 
• Frameworks: Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Maven, Bootstrap CSS. 
• Databases: PostgreSQL, MS SQL, DB2, including design and optimization. 
• Operating Systems: Linux, Windows, Unix. 
• Lifecycle management, software engineering methodologies, test management, and IT governance.
